Summary: Handles timetable assessments, including management of sessions and validations.
Purpose: Facilitate management and validation of assessments tied to timetables within HSPnet.
Entities: UI controls related to timetable assessment.
Fields: Various UI elements like dropdowns for assessor, subject, etc.
Workflows: Load and setup of assessment-related data.
Validations: JavaScript and server-side validation of assessment dates and conditions.
Conditions: Conditional display and handling based on user roles.
System Behavior: Database transactions for managing assessment data.
Dependencies: Extensive dependency on HSPnet resources and framework elements.
